name: oxocarbon-grey
description: A dark cool-grey take on Oxocarbon, with richer syntax colours and full semantic highlighting.

scripts.build: node src/build.mjs && node src/icon.mjs && node src/zed/build.mjs && node src/neovim/build.mjs && node src/ghostty/build.mjs
scripts.check: node src/build.mjs --check && node src/zed/build.mjs --check && node src/neovim/build.mjs --check && node src/ghostty/build.mjs --check && node site/build.mjs --check && node --test src/zed/validate.test.mjs src/neovim/palette.test.mjs src/ghostty/theme.test.mjs
scripts.test:neovim:fixtures: nvim --clean --headless -l tests/neovim/deps.lua && nvim --clean --headless -l tests/neovim/fixtures.lua && nvim --clean --headless -l site/specimens.lua --check
